name: Kitadate Mashiro
source:
Mashiro, [url=/c67336]Yura[/url]'s daughter and [url=/c78582]Mitsuru[/url]'s niece, some years after [url=/c78584]Keisuke[/url]'s death. She is now in kindergarten before moving on to elementary school. 

She is very kind and adorable and loves her mother and Ojii-san very much and she really considers Mitsuru as her real father, even writing a poem to express her love for him.
